_comment: Component-to-asset manifest for the TEAL configurator. One record per component the 3D model can draw (the ids are the COMPINFO keys in index.html). Edit by hand; tools/cad/report.mjs regenerates COVERAGE.md from it and the test suite checks both.

identity.status.class-only: Product data names the class of part and example vendors only

geometry.status.parametric-provisional: Drawn by the parametric builder — illustrative proportions
geometry.status.cad-provisional: From CAD, identity or placement not verified
geometry.status.cad-verified-equivalent: From CAD of a checked equivalent part
geometry.status.cad-verified-exact: From CAD of the exact installed part

cad.status.cad-offered: Search confirmed a CAD download or configurator for this class of part
cad.status.cad-unconfirmed: Manufacturer or distributor page found; CAD not confirmed
cad.status.on-request: CAD stated as available on request, or no public CAD
cad.status.internal-drawing: Fabricated to drawing — only the TEAL project CAD can supply it

cad.verification.verified-exact: Manufacturer and part number matched; geometry consistent with documentation
cad.verification.verified-equivalent: Different model, interfaces and dimensions checked
cad.verification.provisional-reference: Useful geometry, identity or accuracy uncertain

machine.note: No public CAD of any TEAL machine was found. TEAL is Titan Engineering & Automation Limited (a TATA enterprise). No complete enclosed fibre-marking machine assembly was found in public libraries either.

candidates.source: Industrial Automation India — Titan Engineering and Automation Limited (TEAL)

blockers.network: This build environment’s egress policy refuses connections to every CAD library and manufacturer host tried (HTTP 403 on CONNECT); the web-fetch tool could not resolve download.beckhoff.com. No file could be downloaded.
blockers.identity: The product data does not name the installed manufacturer, model or part number for any bought-in component, so no downloaded file could be verified as the exact part even if it were obtained.
